summary.content:
Today's selection covers 53 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 30 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: WhatsApp Leaks User Metadata to Attackers
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft
• **Security Alert**: The Gentlemen ransomware now uses SystemBC for bot-powered attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 28 articles published in the last 24 hours
